manualFollowUps: Pages: merging publishes schood-academy (consent card in learner My mistakes and in the parent page) and schood-platform (consent in the Telegram Mini App homework card). Until the migration and academy-learning are deployed the cards fail to load and stay hidden; nothing else changes.

Database: supabase db push --linked from an isolated migrations folder containing only 20261025210000_academy_homework_mistake_feed.sql. Codex's nine #220 payment migrations stay pending. Dry run first, then supabase migration list --linked. Adds three service-role-only tables, triggers on academy_homework_mistakes and academy_contacts, and the consent commands. Every consent starts off, so no learner data is copied until someone turns it on.

Secrets: none are new. supabase secrets set ACADEMY_LEARNING_WORKER_SECRET=, supabase secrets set TELEGRAM_INTERNAL_SECRET=, supabase secrets set SITE_URL=, supabase secrets set ENGLISH_APP_URL= and supabase secrets set ENGLISH_AI_DAILY_LIMIT= are not run: the lookups already exist in academy-learning and hub and are unchanged (optional or already configured).

Edge: supabase functions deploy academy-learning --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel after the migration (new actions student_mistake_feed[_set], miniapp_mistake_feed[_set], guardian_mistake_feed[_set]).

Edge: supabase functions deploy hub --project-ref bbjawctnqrufvnesdsel (Review shows the teacher's explanation after a homework item; Progress and Review list homework mistakes under their English skill). _shared/english-review.ts only gains an optional field, so grammar-remediation, reading-articles and listening-content need no redeploy.
verification: supabase migration list --linked shows 20261025210000 applied; academy_homework_feed_consents, academy_homework_feed_consent_events and academy_homework_mistake_feed have RLS on and no anon/authenticated grants; select count(*) from academy_homework_feed_consents returns 0.
POST /functions/v1/academy-learning with action student_mistake_feed and no session returns 401; miniapp_mistake_feed with forged initData returns 401.

As a test learner in Academy → My mistakes: the card says Off; Turn on stays disabled until 'I am 18 or older' is ticked; after turning on, english.schood.online/review lists the open homework mistakes and Today offers the matching grammar lesson once a topic has two mistakes; Turn off removes them again.
scripts/fixtures/academy-homework-mistake-feed.sql passes against a dump of the production schema plus this migration (it did on 2026-10-24 against supabase/postgres 17.6.1.063).

rollback.pages: Cloudflare Pages rollback of schood-academy and schood-platform; the cards disappear and nothing else changes.
rollback.migration: To stop copying: drop trigger academy_homework_mistake_feed on academy_homework_mistakes; drop trigger academy_homework_mistake_unfeed on academy_homework_mistakes; drop trigger academy_homework_feed_contact_account on academy_contacts. To remove copies already made: select public.academy_homework_unfeed_contact(academy_id, contact_id) from academy_homework_feed_consents. The tables can stay.
rollback.edge: Redeploy academy-learning and hub from the previous main commit; without the new actions the cards fail to load and stay hidden.
